summary: Frontend-only Playwright E2E for iteration 3 (anatomical 3D brain + basketball strip + chat basketball). Verified all 14 review-request items against http://localhost:3000. Total: 42/42 functional checks PASS, 0 functional FAILS. Initial 3 fails (project-overlay Esc, about 7-skills, theme-toggle) were ALL test-script issues, not app bugs — confirmed PASS on retest: (a) Esc closes overlay correctly when project_overlay handler is attached (first attempt was a race on initial mount), (b) all 7 skill categories exist verbatim ('Languages & Backend', 'Generative AI', 'Cloud', 'ML & Deep Learning', 'Voice & Real-Time', 'DevOps & MLOps', 'Certifications') — I used substring search 'ML' instead of 'ML & Deep Learning' which mismatched, (c) theme toggle testid is 'theme-toggle-btn' (not 'theme-toggle') and DOES toggle from light → dark cosmos theme (verified via screenshot).

issues: App opens in LIGHT theme by default — the neural/cosmos aesthetic (dark space, neon glows, starfield, synapse orbits) is designed for the dark theme and looks significantly more polished there. Consider defaulting to dark or using prefers-color-scheme. Not a functional bug — toggle works correctly.

Procedural shader-displaced cerebrum mesh + 6 anatomical region markers + cerebellum + brainstem render correctly. OrbitControls drag-to-rotate is wired up (drei). Hover-to-detect via WebGL is unreliable in headless Chromium (expected per agent note), but lobe pills drive selection correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: AIBrain.tsx (513-line file) — InteractiveBrain canvas with Cerebrum (shader-displaced ovoid icosahedron + sagittal fissure groove), separate Cerebellum and Brainstem meshes, 6 RegionMarker nodes at anatomically-positioned coordinates, Synapses, PulseOrbit, OrbitControls with auto-rotate. Floating info card (data-testid='brain-info-{id}') in top-right shows subtitle (h3), tagline, 3 bullets (ul li), 3 metric pills, and unlock button (data-testid='brain-info-close') — all working. File is right at the 500-line threshold; if more anatomy is added, consider splitting Cerebrum/Cerebellum/Brainstem into separate component files.

AgentMissionHub.tsx — basketball strip section is well-isolated with court-line aesthetic (concentric rings, side gradients, amber glow). Mentions '3 consecutive inter-college championships' verbatim. 3 stat cards: 3 championships, PG captain/lead, ∞ team flow. cerebellum.signal label ties it back to the brain narrative — strong narrative cohesion.

profile.ts — 6 brain regions are anatomically accurate (frontal front, occipital back, parietal top, temporal left-side, cerebellum bottom-back, brainstem bottom-center). Vision Cortex from iter-2 is correctly REMOVED. Cerebellum has isBasketball=true flag and basketball-specific metrics ('3 in a row', 'Captain', 'Lead PG').

chat/route.ts fallback added a basketball branch (q.includes('basketball') || 'sport' || 'athlete' || 'captain' || 'team') — verified end-to-end: typing 'basketball?' returns the championship-cerebellum response. Suggested chips now include 'Basketball?'.
Theme toggle testid is 'theme-toggle-btn' (works correctly). Worth noting for next testing agent so they don't search for 'theme-toggle'.

Project overlay Esc-to-close: works reliably when overlay is fully mounted (~700ms after click). Backdrop-click-to-close was tested by clicking (10,10) coordinate which hits the chat-toggle pip in top-left of viewport, so backdrop close couldn't be cleanly tested in this iteration — but Esc + close-btn paths both confirmed working (matches iter-2's verdict).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ITER-3 SPECIFICS: (1) Brain region pill testids are 'brain-region-tab-{id}' where id ∈ {frontal,parietal,temporal,occipital,cerebellum,brainstem} — Vision Cortex is REMOVED. (2) After clicking a tab, on desktop (lg+, viewport≥1024) the floating info card appears in top-right with testid 'brain-info-{id}' inside the InteractiveBrain canvas wrapper; on mobile the panel below pills uses testid 'brain-region-panel-{id}'. (3) Unlock button testid is 'brain-info-close'. (4) Basketball strip testid 'basketball-strip' lives between featured-projects and cta-strip. (5) Theme toggle testid is 'theme-toggle-btn' (NOT 'theme-toggle'). (6) Chat suggested chips render only when messages.length <= 1; 'Basketball?' chip testid is 'chat-suggested-Basketball?' (with question mark). (7) /api/chat is a Next.js route — only reachable via localhost:3000, not the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ingress (which routes /api/* to FastAPI). (8) Project overlay Esc-close works but needs ~700ms wait after open click; backdrop-click at (10,10) hits the chat-toggle pip — use a backdrop coordinate further from corners if testing that path.
rca_of_the_issue: No new functional issues found in iteration 3. All review-request items confirmed PASS. The three initial test failures were all test-script defects (wrong testid for theme toggle, substring-only match for skill categories, race on first Esc press) — not app bugs. App is shippable.
